04233 Machaviym {makh-av-eem'}

顯然指某個族人, 但確實地點不詳(複數型, 或用在一單數名詞); 形容詞

AV - Mahavite 1; 1

瑪哈未人 = "繁殖者"
1) 大衛的大能勇士以利業 (#代上 11:46|)
record.edic_text:
04233 Machaviym {makh-av-eem'}

apparently a patrial, but from an unknown place (in the pl.
   only for a sing.);; adj

AV - Mahavite 1; 1

Mahavite = "propagators"
1) apparently, an inhabitant of a place called 'Macheweh'
   1a) the designation of Eliel, one of David's mighty warriors
